content: Service Name Tcp Ip_ Close Syntax Std_ Return Type Tcp Ip_ Close ( Tcp Ip_ Socket Id Type Socket Id, boolean Abort ) Service ID [hex] 0x04 Sync/ Async Asynchronous Reentrancy Reentrant for different Socket Ids. Non reentrant for the same Socket Id. Parameters (in) Socket Id Socket handle identifying the local socket resource. Abort TRUE: connection will immediately be terminated by sending a RST - Segment and releasing all related resources. FALSE: connection will be terminated after performing a regular connection terminatio n handshake and releasing all related resources. Parameters (inout) None Parameters (out) None Return value Std _ - Return - Type E_ OK: The request has been accepted E_ NOT_ OK: The request has not been accepted. Description By this API service the TCP/ IP stack is requested to close the socket and release all related resources. Available via Tcp Ip.h
